mapper.sql: select job.batch_job_id as "batchId", case when job.batch_type = 'SCORE_RECALCULATION' then 'RECALCULATION' when job.batch_type in ('FINALIZATION','FINALIZATION_CANCEL') then 'CONFIRMATION' else job.batch_type end as "batchType", job.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", job.area_code as "areaCode", job.organization_code as "organizationCode", job.target_user_id as "targetUserId", concat_ws(' / ', '평가연도 ' || job.evaluation_year, case when job.area_code is not null then '영역 ' || job.area_code end, case when job.organization_code is not null then '조직 ' || job.organization_code end, case when job.target_user_id is not null then '대상자 ' || job.target_user_id end, case when job.target_condition_json ->> 'formulaVersion' is not null then '산식버전 ' || job.target_condition_json ->> 'formulaVersion' end, case when job.target_condition_json ->> 'previewToken' is not null then '미리보기 ' || job.target_condition_json ->> 'previewToken' end, case when job.target_condition_json ->> 'transition' is not null then '전이 ' || job.target_condition_json ->> 'transition' end ) as "targetConditionSummary", job.total_count as "totalCount", job.success_count as "successCount", job.failure_count as "failureCount", job.excluded_count as "excludedCount", job.job_status as "jobStatus", job.requested_by as "requestedBy", job.requested_at as "requestedAt", job.request_id as "requestId" from evaluation_batch_jobs job

where.if: and ( job.target_condition_json::text ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedTargetCondition}, '%') or job.evaluation_year ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedTargetCondition}, '%') or coalesce(job.area_code, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedTargetCondition}, '%') or coalesce(job.organization_code, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedTargetCondition}, '%') or coalesce(job.target_user_id::text, '') ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedTargetCondition}, '%') )

mapper.select: order by job.requested_at desc, job.batch_job_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

select item.batch_job_item_id as "batchJobItemId", item.batch_job_id as "batchId", item.target_ref as "targetRef", item.result_status as "resultStatus", item.error_code as "errorCode", item.error_message as "errorMessage", item.excluded_reason as "excludedReason", item.processed_at as "processedAt" from evaluation_batch_job_items item where item.batch_job_id = #{batchId} and item.result_status in ('FAILURE', 'EXCLUDED') order by case item.result_status when 'FAILURE' then 0 else 1 end, item.processed_at desc, item.batch_job_item_id desc
